decision: decision unchanged based on accessible curated evidence
scope: Bounded accessible evidence only; not adjudication of inaccessible literature
rationale: The new evidence improves biological/contextual interpretation and tool options, but no integrated study establishes exposure-matched cellular ERAP1 engagement or chemical-genetic dependency for the baseline phenotype-producing compounds. It does not warrant changing the canonical compound-scoped decision or claiming that inaccessible evidence confirms it.

critical_uncertainty.interpretation: Priority unchanged; interpretation refined: demonstrate engagement at phenotype-active exposure in a defined ERAP1 allotype/HLA/ERAP2 context, with substrate and intracellular-versus-surface readouts distinguished.

recommended_experiment.rationale: Retain matched-genotype chemical-genetic engagement design. Strengthen specification of full allotype, HLA-B27 subtype, ERAP2 status, peptide substrate and dose/time. Measure engagement and phenotype at the same exposures; distinguish surface FHC from intracellular folding/UPR; compare WT/null/rescue plus vehicle, viability, assay interference and inactive analogue where genuinely established. Do not assume that lifelong KO predicts partial-drug or allosteric effects. Broader allotype/immune or disease-model work follows mechanism discrimination rather than replacing it.

chemical_learning.rationale: Literature assertions are not standardized learning measurements. Recent chemistry was not pooled across construct/substrate/endpoint or promoted past identity/SI gaps. The unchanged indexed Phase 3.9 dataset retains its refusal; eligibility for all newly published chemistry is NOT ASSESSED, not declared universally ineligible.

competing_explanations.after: biologically better contextualized; compound mechanism not resolved
competing_explanations.rationale: Genetic perturbation and new tool pharmacology support plausibility, not baseline compound occupancy/dependency.
A limited new-series counter-screen does not resolve selectivity of the baseline perturbagens.
Broader proteomic effects supply plausible indirect pathways but do not prove the AS compound mechanism.
Population, HLA, allotype, substrate, compartment and disease endpoint can alter interpretation; no alternative is removed.

questions.answer: Recent accessible human association and rat perturbation strengthen target–AS biology, not validated therapeutic benefit.
Human stratification, CD8 subtype comparisons and B27/B7 model divergence strengthen HLA-context evidence.
Full allotype, HLA and substrate context matter; single SNPs and complete allotypes are not interchangeable.
No universally preferred therapeutic direction established. Protective association, substrate-dependent activity and mixed organ outcomes do not choose inhibition for every patient.
New accessible recombinant pharmacology and cyclohexyl acid assays add biochemical evidence within specified contexts.
Patient PBMC and expanded CD8 data add human cellular context; the seeded macrophage drug study remains abstract-only and is not adjudicated.
Integrated structures and cellular phenotypes do not establish exposure-matched cellular engagement for the baseline phenotype-producing compounds.
Parallel KO and inhibitor effects are not a matched inhibitor-in-null/rescue chemical-genetic dependency test.
New-series counter-screen evidence is informative but sparse and cross-substrate; no selectivity ratio computed or baseline selectivity resolved.
Germline ERAP1 loss modifies arthritis incidence in one experimental SpA model, with no improved GI clinical score and worse colon histology; not reversal of established disease.
An ERAP1-directed axSpA trial registration was identified, but no AS/axSpA human interventional efficacy results were identified in the searched sources. This does not claim that no trial exists.
REFINED wording/context; target engagement remains the critical uncertainty, not resolved or replaced.
REFINED_EXPERIMENT: retain the chemical-genetic engagement design with more explicit allotype/substrate/compartment and exposure controls.
No new standardized learning measurements imported, so the indexed model refusal is unchanged. Eligibility of the entire recent chemical literature was not assessed.

commercial.coverage_wording: The assessment incorporates a bounded addendum of recent primary studies from 2020–2026 for which sufficient methods and results were accessible for AXIS scientific curation.
commercial.inaccessible_wording: Additional potentially material literature was identified but not adjudicated where full methodological information was unavailable.
